project_type: Telegram Bot (aiogram 3.x) with Firebase Realtime Database
build_system: pip install from requirements.txt; runs via Procfile on Railway
verification_instructions: 1. Install dependencies with pip. 2. Verify the bot.py file imports cleanly without syntax errors. 3. Verify key functions exist and have correct signatures.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No Firebase connection available for runtime testing. Validation is limited to syntax check and import verification.
contribution_requirements: Single file project (bot.py). All changes go into bot.py.
key_patterns: 1. All buttons use _b() helper for bold Unicode text. 2. Keyboards are built with _kb(*rows) helper. 3. Firebase operations use db_get/db_set/db_update/db_delete async helpers. 4. Admin handlers use AdminFlow states; user handlers use UserFlow states. 5. Products have a 'hidden' boolean field. User-facing listings filter out hidden=True. 6. Stock management: add_stock_items(), pop_stock_items(), clear_stock(). 7. The bot uses reply keyboards exclusively (no inline keyboards for navigation).
directory_structure: Single file project: bot.py (6984 lines), requirements.txt, Procfile, railway.toml, README.md
